h1: Custom Cotton Gloves for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom cotton gloves for your team or event. Perfect for branding, comfort, and bulk orders from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton gloves offer a soft, breathable alternative to synthetic materials, making them ideal for light-duty tasks, trade show giveaways, or uniform accessories. Unlike nitrile or latex, cotton provides comfort for all-day wear and absorbs moisture, which is useful for handling delicate items or general maintenance. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands out.
heroAltText: Bulk custom cotton gloves with embroidered logo displayed on a workbench
